sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在以一种切合实际的方式优先关注自己的健康，而让我保持高昂动力的秘诀就是我的WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个极其注重数据的人，这就是我热爱WHOOP的原因，因为我能真切地看出为什么在不同的日子里我的身体会有不同的感受，为什么我跑步的状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我可能没那么专注。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP能轻松追踪我的睡眠、运动强度、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，还有我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供所有的这些数据和规律，以便我能做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该拼搏。

sentences.zh: 有些人保留着他们所有的旧演唱会门票。

sentences.en: It brings back the music, it brings back the memories, even the smells.
sentences.zh: 它能唤回音乐，唤回记忆，甚至是当年的气味。

sentences.en: Other people collect perfume bottles or coffee mugs or overseas banknotes, classic sweaters from the 80s.
sentences.zh: 其他人则收集香水瓶、咖啡马克杯、海外纸币，或是80年代的经典毛衣。

sentences.en: Collection is deeply personal.
sentences.zh: 收藏是一件极其私人的事情。

sentences.zh: 它诉说着我们是谁，但也诉说着我们来自何方。

sentences.zh: 在全新的播客节目《山姆的魅力世界》中，

sentences.en: Sam explores the memories, obsessions, and tiny treasures that become part of who we are.
sentences.zh: 山姆探索了构成我们之所是的那些记忆、执念与微小宝藏。

sentences.zh: 《山姆的魅力世界》。

sentences.zh: 这是潘多拉为您呈现的故事。

sentences.en: Hello everybody, I'm Gemma Spake, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through the biggest changes, moments, and transitions of our 20s,
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是珍娜·斯派克，欢迎回到《你二十多岁的心理学》，在这里我们探讨二十多岁时经历的巨大改变、重要时刻与人生转型，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理的意义。

sentences.en: Hello everybody, welcome back to the show, welcome back to the podcast, and thank you for tuning in as we break down another episode on the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到节目，欢迎回到本期播客，感谢收听我们关于“二十岁心理学”的又一期节目。

sentences.en: So this is more of a personal episode.
sentences.zh: 所以，这更像是一期个人分享节目。

sentences.en: I guess there's been something on my mind recently or something I've been really contemplating in the last few months is that I've spent my entire 20s essentially recording my life
sentences.zh: 我想最近我心里一直在盘算着一件事，或者说在过去几个月里我一直在深思的一点是，我的整个二十多岁几乎都是在记录我的生活度过的，

sentences.en: and kind of bringing you guys on this journey with me over the past five to six years.
sentences.zh: 在过去五到六年里，某种程度上可以说是带着大家一起经历了这段旅程。

sentences.en: I've recorded nearly everything that has happened to me, every experience that I've had, all my life lessons since I was 20, 21, and last week, you know,
sentences.zh: 我记录了几乎所有发生在自己身上的事，我的每一次经历，以及自我20岁、21岁以来的所有人生成长课，上周，你知道的，

sentences.en: I had the privilege now of being able to listen back to these episodes, and I listened back to an episode I made right at the beginning in December, 2021,
sentences.zh: 我有幸能够回听这些节目，我回听了我在2021年12月刚开始时制作的一期节目，

sentences.en: like the first year I was making this podcast, and I recorded this episode titled
sentences.zh: 就像我做这个播客的第一年一样，我录制了这期题为

sentences.en: The Psychology of Big Life Changers.
sentences.zh: 《重大生活改变的心理学》的节目。

sentences.en: At the time, I was just about to move to Sydney.
sentences.zh: 当时，我正准备搬去悉尼。

sentences.en: I had just graduated university.
sentences.zh: 我刚从大学毕业。

sentences.en: I was heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 我心碎欲绝。

sentences.en: I didn't know what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我不知道自己在做什么。

sentences.en: I don't, did I have a job?
sentences.zh: 我不，我当时有工作吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't think I did.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我当时没有。

sentences.en: And there was so much advice that I wanted to give this version of myself as I listened to this episode.
sentences.zh: 当我回听那期节目时，有太多太多的建议我想对那个时期的自己说。

sentences.en: And it really got me thinking, what advice would 31, 32, 33-year-old Gemma have for me now during this chapter?
sentences.zh: 这真的让我陷入了深思：31岁、32岁、33岁的珍娜会对现阶段的我有什么建议呢？

sentences.en: There's just so much that doesn't become apparent until you've lived through something.
sentences.zh: 有些事情，只有当你真正经历过后才会变得显而易见。

sentences.en: And I cannot tell what 32-year-old me is thinking of this episode or any of the other episodes that I make, but I do know what I would have told my younger self at the time
sentences.zh: 我无法揣测32岁的我会如何看待这期节目或我制作的其他任何节目，但我确实知道，如果回听那期节目，我会对当时的那个年轻的自己说些什么

sentences.en: listening back to that episode.
sentences.zh: 听着那期节目时的感悟。

sentences.en: And as I thought about it more, I thought it would make a really interesting topic and a really interesting kind of exercise to think.
sentences.zh: 随着我深入思考，我觉得这会是一个非常有趣的话题，也是一个很有深度的思考练习。

sentences.en: If I was going to tell her, you know, five, six, seven things, what would they be?
sentences.zh: 如果我要对她说，你知道的，五、六、七件事，那会是什么？

sentences.en: What would I scream at her?
sentences.zh: 我会对她大喊什么？

sentences.en: And I guess also, what would I tell you guys?
sentences.zh: 我想，我也会对你们说些什么呢？

sentences.en: So if somebody who's a little bit younger than me listening to this episode who's in their early 20s about how to make the most of like this next chapter in their life.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果收听这期节目的听众比我年轻一点、正处于二十岁出头，想知道如何充分利用人生中接下来的这个章节。

sentences.en: I made so many mistakes in my early 20s.
sentences.zh: 我在二十出头时犯了太多的错误。

sentences.en: And if I'm being honest, I would do about 90% of them again.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，其中大约90%的错误我还是会再犯一遍。

sentences.en: And then there are some that I wouldn't do.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些是我不会去做的。

sentences.en: This list contains a bit of a mixture.
sentences.zh: 这个清单包含了一点混合的内容。

sentences.en: It contains all these things that I really think were the biggest lessons I took from this time in my life that was just chaos and there was nothing really that I could hold on to.
sentences.zh: 它包含了所有这些事情，我真的认为它们是我从这段混乱不堪、没有什么真正可以依靠的人生时期中汲取的最宝贵的教训。

sentences.en: And yet I've made it through.
sentences.zh: 然而我还是挺过来了。

sentences.en: And this like, I don't know if I would call it wisdom, this loose wisdom that I have is like kind of all I had to show for it.
sentences.zh: 这种，我不知道该不该称之为智慧的东西，这种我所拥有的零星智慧，就像是我留下的全部证明。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to share those lessons with you.
sentences.zh: 我只是想和你们分享这些教训。

sentences.en: And also I wanted to hear perhaps what you guys would say to your younger selves.
sentences.zh: 我也很想听听你们会对年轻时的自己说些什么。

sentences.en: If there was something that you could literally
sentences.zh: 如果有什么事情，你可以字面意义上地

sentences.en: grab younger you by the shoulders and be like, just listen to me.
sentences.zh: 抓住年轻时的自己的肩膀说：听我说。

sentences.en: I'm from the future.
sentences.zh: 我来自未来。

sentences.en: Don't do this.
sentences.zh: 别这么做。

sentences.en: Just do that.
sentences.zh: 就做那个。

sentences.en: Please think differently about this experience.
sentences.zh: 请对这段经历抱有不同的看法。

sentences.en: What would it be?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么？

sentences.en: Here is my liSt.
sentences.zh: 这是我的清单。

sentences.en: Feel free to share your own.
sentences.zh: 欢迎分享你们自己的经历。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，我们切入正题吧。

sentences.en: Let's start off with number one.
sentences.zh: 让我们从第一点开始。

sentences.en: These days, you guys know, I am in like the most amazing relationship.
sentences.zh: 这些天你们也知道，我正处于一段无比美妙的恋爱中。

sentences.en: I love my boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 我很爱我的男朋友。

sentences.en: I kind of understand all those like funny sayings people used to have in movies where they would be like, you know, he's my best friend.
sentences.zh: 我有点理解电影里那些搞笑的台词了，比如他们会说，你知道的，他是我的最好朋友。

sentences.en: And like, I fall in love more every single day.
sentences.zh: 而且，我感觉自己每一天都比前一天更爱他。

sentences.en: And like that idea of like puppy love, like I get it.
sentences.zh: 就像那种初恋般的感觉，我懂了。

sentences.en: And it genuinely, it's gag worthy sometimes.
sentences.zh: 而且说实话，有时候真的肉麻到让人想吐。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: But he truly is like the, just the beSt.
sentences.zh: 但他真的是，简直就是最棒的。

sentences.en: He's so principled.
sentences.zh: 他很有原则。

sentences.en: He's so funny.
sentences.zh: 他太有趣了。

sentences.en: He's the best person I know.
sentences.zh: 他是我认识的最好的人。

sentences.en: Now, before this relationship,
sentences.zh: 然而在这段感情之前，

sentences.en: I had some shockers.
sentences.zh: 我遇到过一些奇葩。

sentences.en: If you've listened to me for a while, you'll know that I documented them on this very podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你听我的节目有一段时间了，你就会知道我正是把这些记录在这个播客上的。

sentences.en: And the biggest thing I took away from it.
sentences.zh: 我从中得到的最大收获。

sentences.en: And the first thing my 21 year old self would be hearing from me and would be getting an earful about if I could talk to her right now would be that the right person
sentences.zh: 如果我现在能跟21岁的自己对话，她从我这里听到的第一件事、也会被我狠狠唠叨一番的事就是：对的人

sentences.en: will never force you to compromise your friends.
sentences.zh: 绝不会强迫你在朋友问题上做出妥协。

sentences.en: Period.
sentences.zh: 句号。

sentences.en: Full stop.
sentences.zh: 到此为止。

sentences.en: Never, ever, ever.
sentences.zh: 绝不，绝不，绝不。

sentences.en: They will never make you choose between them or me.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会让你在“他们”和“我”之间做选择。

sentences.en: And the right relationship should never put you in a position where you are willing to go against your deeply held loyalties and your deeply held bonds with these people
sentences.zh: 一段正确的亲密关系绝不应该把你置于这样一种境地：为了一个男人、一个女人或是一段浪漫关系，你愿意违背你对这些人的坚定忠诚以及跟他们的深厚纽带

sentences.en: for a man, a woman, or a romantic relationship.
sentences.zh: 去妥协。

sentences.en: Now, this is a lesson I learned.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这是一个教训。

sentences.en: I learned it way too late.
sentences.zh: 我明白得太晚了。

sentences.en: And it's part of those rare 10% of mistakes I would not make again and I would choose to do differently if I could and if I knew better.
sentences.zh: 它属于那罕见的10%我不会再犯的错误，如果时光倒流且我早知如此，我会选择做出不同的做法。

sentences.en: Now, does that mean your partner has to become best friends with all your best friends?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否意味着你的伴侣必须和你的所有好朋友都成为最好的朋友呢？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是的。

sentences.en: Like, that's obviously nice.
sentences.zh: 就像，那当然很好。

sentences.en: You would hope they would get along.
sentences.zh: 你希望他们能合得来。

sentences.en: I don't think that's necessary.
sentences.zh: 但我认为那并非必要。

sentences.en: I don't think that they need to be buddy, buddy, buddy.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他们需要好得像哥们儿一样黏在一起。

sentences.en: But what they shouldn't be doing is getting in your ear and, like, bad-mouthing these people and judging you for spending time with them or using manipulative tactics.
sentences.zh: 但他们不该做的是在你耳边吹风，说这些人的坏话，评判你和他们相处的时间，或者使用操纵手段。

sentences.en: So, you know, guilt or shame or the silent treatment to get you to prioritize them and them only.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，通过负罪感、羞耻感或冷暴力来让你把优先顺位置于他们、且仅仅是他们身上。

sentences.en: And I don't think they should be in your ear saying nasty things about these people and you certainly shouldn't be listening.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们不应该总在你耳边说这些人的坏话，你也绝不应该去听信。

sentences.en: I think it's also true that they say that, you know, the right person should bring out the best in you and that's not the best if they make you or turn you against your friend.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得他们说得对，你知道的，对的人应该激发出你最好的一面，但如果他们让你或者迫使你与朋友反目，那就不是最好的一面了。

sentences.en: Friends, plural.
sentences.zh: 朋友，复数形式。

sentences.en: There is this idea in psychology known as the self-expansion theory of love.
sentences.zh: 心理学中有一个概念被称为爱的自我扩展理论。

sentences.en: It was coined by Arthur and Elaine Aron in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 它是由亚瑟和伊莱恩·阿伦在20世纪80年代提出的。

sentences.en: And it essentially says being in love is a pathway to personal expansion.
sentences.zh: 它基本上表明，陷入爱河是通往个人自我扩展的一条途径。

sentences.en: One of many pathways, but a pathway because the best aspects of somebody else get incorporated into our own self-concept and that results in deeper self-knowledge.
sentences.zh: 它是众多途径之一，但确实是一条途径，因为别人身上最好的特质会被融合进我们自己的自我概念中，从而带来更深层次的自我认知。

sentences.en: Yeah, there were a lot of relationships that did the opposite.
sentences.zh: 是的，有很多段感情却起到了相反的作用。

sentences.en: They did not expand me.
sentences.zh: 它们没有扩展我。

sentences.en: They shrunk me.
sentences.zh: 它们反而让我缩小了。

sentences.en: They made my world smaller.
sentences.zh: 它们让我的世界变小了。

sentences.en: They made me hate myself.
sentences.zh: 它们让我憎恨自己。

sentences.en: And a lot of that came down to the influence they had on my friendships and the friendships that they caused me to lose because they wanted me to prioritize them.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上归结于他们对我的友情产生的影响，以及他们导致我失去的那些朋友，因为他们希望我把他们放在首位。

sentences.en: So younger Gemma, listen to me right now.
sentences.zh: 所以年轻的珍娜，现在就听我的。

sentences.en: Run as far away from these people as you can and as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽可能远离这些人，跑得越远越好，而且要越快越好。

sentences.en: So that's number one.
sentences.zh: 这就是第一点。

sentences.en: That's the first thing she would be hearing from me about.
sentences.zh: 这就是她会从我这里听到的第一件事。

sentences.en: Now, second,
sentences.zh: 现在，第二点，

sentences.en: please do not try and play house with somebody before it is your time.
sentences.zh: 在时候未到之前，请不要试图和某人过家家。

sentences.en: Again, another love-based one, but why in the world did I contemplate or even think for a second that moving in with my boyfriend at 21 was going to be a good idea?
sentences.zh: 同样，这也是一段基于爱情的感悟，但为什么我竟然会考虑甚至哪怕有一秒钟觉得21岁时跟男朋友同居会是个好主意？

sentences.en: Why did I seriously think?
sentences.zh: 为什么我会认真地觉得？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's totally about time that I start settling down.
sentences.zh: 对啊，我觉得完全是时候开始安定下来了。

sentences.en: This man is totally my forever.
sentences.zh: 这个男人绝对是我的一生挚爱。

sentences.en: This seems comfortable.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很舒服。

sentences.en: This feels like the right adult step.
sentences.zh: 这感觉像是成年人该迈出的正确一步。

sentences.en: Why did I think that?
sentences.zh: 我当时为什么会这么想？

sentences.en: I have a lot of grace for that version of me.
sentences.zh: 我对那个时期的自己抱有极大的包容。

sentences.en: I think a lot of us feel drawn towards this kind of move because we kind of want to appear older than we are, especially in our early 20s.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们很多人都会被这种举动所吸引，因为我们有点想显得比实际年龄成熟，尤其是在二十出头的时候。

sentences.en: And we particularly want people around us, adults, to take us seriously and to see our relationships as important.
sentences.zh: 我们特别希望周围的人，也就是成年人，能认真对待我们，把我们的感情看得很重要。

sentences.en: So one way that we do that is that we mimic what we see or saw them doing or what we think is socially correct.
sentences.zh: 所以我们做到这一点的方法之一，就是模仿我们看到的或曾经看到他们做过的事情，或者我们认为在社交上正确的事情。

sentences.en: And we try and force these adult moves too soon.
sentences.zh: 然后我们试图过早地推进这些成年人的举动。

sentences.en: You know, there is this deep social conditioning that your life begins when you find a partner and you move in with that person and you fall in love with that person
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有一种根深蒂固的社会规训，认为你的人生始于你找到了一个伴侣，和那个人同居，与那个人坠入爱河，

sentences.en: and you are forever now and like you are this partnership.
sentences.zh: 然后你们就永远在一起了，就像你们是一个整体伙伴关系一样。

sentences.en: You and them are not separated.
sentences.zh: 你和他们是不可分割的。

sentences.en: But I really do believe that the ability to have independent experiences before you make this move is insanely, insanely important.
sentences.zh: 但我真的坚信，在迈出这一步之前，拥有独立的生活经历是极其、极其重要的。

sentences.en: I am a firm believer that everything has its time and you really do have to focus and appreciate the chapter you are in right now rather than speeding towards the next milestone
sentences.zh: 我坚信万物皆有其时，你真的必须专注于并欣赏你当下所处的这个章节，而不是比预期更快地冲向下一个里程碑。

sentences.en: faster than you need to get there.
sentences.zh: 无需急于求成。

sentences.en: If you are 21 and there is no legitimate or legal or important reason for you to move in with your partner, do not do it.
sentences.zh: 如果你才21岁，而且没有任何合法的、法律上的或重要原因非要跟伴侣同居不可，那就别这么做。

sentences.en: Don't do it.
